main_measure.name: pooled mean of forecast/10 x excess 24-bar return on the 24-bar grid
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2; at least 1,000 independent cases

supporting_check.name: top-fifth minus bottom-fifth |forecast| mean of sign(forecast) x excess 24-bar return

decided_by: Pooled mean positive with t >= 2 over at least 1,000 cases, and the top-fifth minus bottom-fifth Welch t is >= 2.
reading: The coin's mean 24-bar return is the mean of its grid returns over all windows; the top and bottom fifths are the rank-based top and bottom 20% of grid bars by |forecast| within each coin, pooled across coins; the supporting check passes when that difference is positive with Welch t >= 2; too few cases are reported as not observable.
